The final two courses (COU1600 and COU4852) provide a deep dive into machine learning concepts and apply machine learning operations to real-world problems, respectively.

| 10 | COU305 | Capstone and Practice Exam (AZ-500) | Coursera | Practical application of cloud computing and DevOps skills |

**Path Explanation**

This learning path is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of cloud computing and DevOps concepts, from foundational knowledge to hands-on experience with cloud-native architecture. The path starts with introductory courses on cloud computing and DevOps, followed by specialized courses on PaaS, IaaS, and Google Cloud DevOps. The path then delves into cloud security and cloud applications, and finally, provides hands-on experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native architecture. The path is structured to provide a gradual acquisition of skills, with a balance between theoretical knowledge and practical application. The learner will be able to see the relevance of cloud computing and DevOps concepts to their own projects or goals, and receive regular feedback on their progress.

learning_path:
**Learning Path Table**
| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU5529 | International Humanitarian Law in Theory and Practice | Coursera | Foundational understanding of international humanitarian law |
| 2 | COU1244 | International Law In Action: Investigating and Prosecuting International Crimes | Coursera | Contextualization and real-world connections to international law and justice |
| 3 | COU890 | Children's Human Rights - An Interdisciplinary Introduction | Coursera | Emphasis on empathy and perspective-taking, understanding children's human rights |
| 4 | COU1205 | Introduction to International Criminal Law | Coursera | Gradual complexity, building on prior knowledge of international law and justice |
| 5 | COU413 | International Law in Action: A Guide to the International Courts and Tribunals in The Hague | Coursera | Emphasis on critical thinking and analysis, understanding international courts and tribunals |
| 6 | COU3152 | Human Rights for Open Societies | Coursera | Emphasis on empathy and perspective-taking, understanding human rights in open societies |
| 7 | COU5181 | Climate Change and Human Rights | Coursera | Contextualization and real-world connections, understanding human rights in the context of climate change |
| 8 | COU5028 | Violence Against Healthcare | Coursera | Emphasis on empathy and perspective-taking, understanding violence against healthcare |
| 9 | COU6411 | Global Diplomacy: the United Nations in the World | Coursera | Emphasis on critical thinking and analysis, understanding global diplomacy and the United Nations |
| 10 | COU5708 | Privacy in the Western World | Coursera | Gradual complexity, building on prior knowledge of human rights and international law |

**Learning Path Explanation**

This learning path provides a comprehensive and structured approach to human rights and international humanitarian law. The path starts with a foundational understanding of international humanitarian law (COU5529) and gradually builds on this knowledge with courses that contextualize and connect theoretical concepts to real-world scenarios (COU1244, COU413). The path then emphasizes empathy and perspective-taking with courses on children's human rights (COU890), human rights in open societies (COU3152), and human rights in the context of climate change (COU5181). The path also encourages critical thinking and analysis with courses on international law and justice (COU1205), global diplomacy and the United Nations (COU6411), and the intersection of human rights and healthcare (COU5028). **Learning Path for Supply Chain and Operations Management**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| 3 | COU5702 | Supply Chain Principles | Coursera | This course provides a solid understanding of supply chain principles, including procurement, supply chain, and transporting. It leverages graphics to promote the Integrated Supply Chain model. |
| 4 | EDX1505 | Supply Chains for Manufacturing: Inventory Analytics | edX | This course applies concepts and models for effective supply chain and manufacturing system planning, operational tactics for managing variability, and integrated planning and collaboration. |
| 5 | COU2553 | Supply Chain Management Strategy | Coursera | This course is the capstone of the Supply Chain Management specialization, providing a comprehensive understanding of supply chain strategy, supply chain risk management, and supply chain. |
| 6 | EDX210 | Supply Chain Comprehensive Exam | edX | This course is a comprehensive exam that covers content from all five courses of the SCM MicroMasters series, including supply chain management, supply chain, and business & management. |
| 7 | COU2924 | Supply Chain Operations | Coursera | This course provides a beginner-level introduction to supply chain operations, covering topics such as lean six sigma, supply chain, and six sigma. |
| 8 | EDX2883 | Supply Chain Planning and Strategy | edX | This course provides an overview of supply chain management, including the linkages between operations management and financial results, and how a supply chain design is developed based on a competitive business strategy. |
| 9 | COU5597 | Supply Chain Excellence Specialization | Coursera | This course provides an advanced-level introduction to supply chain excellence, covering topics such as operations management, global procurement, logistics, warehouse operations, and supply chain analysis. |
| 10 | EDX3338 | Operations Management | edX | This course provides a comprehensive understanding of operations management, including lean thinking, improving overall efficiency, quality, and waste management, and business operation risk and how to avoid it. |

**Path Explanation**

This learning path is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of supply chain and operations management for a manufacturing role. The path starts with a foundational course on supply chain management, followed by a course on operations management that builds on the foundational knowledge. The next course provides a solid understanding of supply chain principles, including procurement, supply chain, and transporting. The path then applies concepts and models for effective supply chain and manufacturing system planning, operational tactics for managing variability, and integrated planning and collaboration. The capstone course is a comprehensive exam that covers content from all five courses of the SCM MicroMasters series. The final course provides a beginner-level introduction to supply chain operations, covering topics such as lean six sigma, supply chain, and six sigma. The path concludes with a comprehensive overview of supply chain planning and strategy, including the linkages between operations management and financial results, and how a supply chain design is developed based on a competitive business strategy.

learning_path:
**Learning Path for Data Science in 6 Months**
=============================================

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1-2 weeks | COU4368 | Introduction to Data Science Specialization | Coursera | Foundational knowledge of data science, including Python programming, cloud databases, and SQL. |
| 2-4 weeks | COU4368 | Introduction to Data Science Specialization | Coursera | Builds on previous knowledge, introducing data visualization, machine learning, and deep learning concepts. |
| 4-6 weeks | COU4368 | Introduction to Data Science Specialization | Coursera | Focuses on practical application of data science concepts, with projects and case studies. |
| 2-4 weeks | COU4368 | Introduction to Data Science Specialization | Coursera | Emphasizes data manipulation, visualization, and modeling, with a focus on developing a strong foundation in data science. |
| 4-6 weeks | COU4368 | Introduction to Data Science Specialization | Coursera | Covers advanced topics like machine learning and deep learning, with a focus on practical application and impact. |
| 6 weeks | COU4368 | Introduction to Data Science Specialization | Coursera | Provides regular milestones and assessments to help the learner track progress, stay motivated, and adjust their pace as needed. |

The learning path is designed to provide a solid foundation in data science, with a focus on practical application and impact. The course sequence is structured to build skills in a logical order, with a focus on developing a strong foundation in data manipulation, visualization, and modeling before moving on to more advanced topics like machine learning and deep learning. The path is designed to be flexible, with regular milestones and assessments to help the learner track progress and adjust their pace as needed.

**Learning Path for Leadership Development**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | EDX3423 | Leadership Program | edx | Foundational knowledge of leadership principles and team dynamics |

| 3 | EDX720 | Becoming an Effective Leader | edx | Developing essential soft skills, such as communication, conflict resolution, and emotional intelligence |
| 4 | EDX3422 | The Leader as Coach | edx | Practical application of leadership skills, with a focus on coaching and interpersonal relationships |
| 5 | EDX3413 | Managing Technical Professionals | edx | Emphasis on team performance management, innovation, and effective communication |

| 7 | EDX3417 | Leadership in an Exponentially Changing World | edx | Ongoing practice and feedback, with a focus on adapting to changing team dynamics and staying motivated |
| 8 | EDX3347 | Organizational Leadership | edx | Advanced leadership skills, with a focus on cross-functional collaboration, organizational effectiveness, and management |
| 9 | EDX3222 | Oxford Executive Leadership Programme | edx | Final course, providing a comprehensive toolkit for effective leadership and a refined understanding of leadership purpose and values |

The learning path is designed to provide a gradual progression from foundational knowledge to advanced leadership skills. Each course builds on the previous one, with a focus on practical application, soft skills development, and ongoing practice and feedback. The path covers a range of topics, including leadership principles, team dynamics, organizational change, and self-awareness. By the end of the path, the learner will have a comprehensive toolkit for effective leadership and a refined understanding of leadership purpose and values.

| 3 | COU3372 | High-Impact Business Writing | Coursera | Focuses on email writing, proofreading, and communication skills for business writing |
| 4 | COU4038 | Write Professional Emails in English | Coursera | Develops skills for writing effective business emails in English, including grammar, vocabulary, and cross-cultural knowledge |
| 5 | COU5890 | Business English for Cross-cultural Communication | Coursera | Prepares learners for working in a cross-cultural business setting, combining language skills with cross-cultural knowledge |
| 6 | COU5782 | Training and Practicing in English Public Speaking | Coursera | Develops public speaking skills, including pronunciation, listening, and writing, for effective communication |
| 7 | COU1509 | Become a Journalist: Report the News! Specialization | Coursera | Focuses on news writing, multimedia, and journalism skills for effective communication in a business setting |
| 8 | COU4323 | Business Case Analysis | Coursera | Applies written and spoken skills to an authentic business situation, with a focus on business case analysis and communication |

**Learning Path Explanation**

This learning path is designed to support non-native English speakers in developing their business writing and professional communication skills. The path starts with foundational courses, such as Business Writing (COU2851) and English for Effective Business Writing (COU5945), which establish a strong understanding of English grammar, vocabulary, and sentence structure. The next courses focus on developing specific skills, such as email writing (COU3372) and cross-cultural communication (COU5890). The path then shifts to public speaking and journalism skills, with Training and Practicing in English Public Speaking (COU5782) and Become a Journalist: Report the News! Specialization (COU1509). Finally, the path concludes with a focus on business case analysis and communication, with Business Case Analysis (COU4323). This learning path is designed to be incremental, with each course building on the previous one, and to provide a clear and achievable learning schedule with regular milestones and feedback.
